answer: Work history is time-locked. A record vests 60 days before it spends, any single peer can file a challenge, and one upheld challenge revokes the whole record. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name, so renaming changes nothing. Post copper stake, wait out the lock, clear one replay check. A lotus of 200 clones needs 200 locks and 12,000 waiting days, and the jetty admits one submission per epoch.
